description: Bodenkarte von Niedersachsen 1 : 50 000 - Deichlinien im Küstenholozän is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by nibis.lbeg.de. The representation of the dike lines in the coastal Holocene was developed by Lower Saxony in the course of the processing of the soil map on a scale of 1:50,000. They are of fundamental importance for the landscape and soil development in the march and sometimes also form soil boundaries. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Ground map of Lower Saxony 1 : 50 000 - Ditch lines in the Coastal Holocene" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include NIBIS-Metadaten, inspireidentifiziert, opendata, sgd_Boden. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
